facts.text: Amazon Pay ICICI Bank credit-card holders with Prime membership can earn up to 5% rewards on eligible Amazon purchases, credited to Amazon Pay balance. This card has no joining or annual fee; card terms and exclusions apply.

The Amazon Pay ICICI Bank credit-card FAQ lists 3 months of No Cost EMI on eligible Amazon.in transactions. This statement concerns that card programme; eligibility and product terms need confirmation before purchase.
